subject: problems specifying bin breaks in stat_bin

messages.author: 52f1e4a2018ad5fa
messages.subject: problems specifying bin breaks in stat_bin
parts:
Hi everybody,

I'm having trouble using stat_bin when I specify the breaks in the bins. Below is an example that reproduces the problem and the error I get when I try to run it. When I leave the breaks argument to stat_bin out the graph is rendered. Can anybody tell me what I'm doing wrong here?

Thanks, 

Colm.
------------------------------------------------------------------

R version 2.15.1
ggplot2 version 0.9.1

rm(list=ls())
graphics.off()

library(ggplot2)

df=data.frame(sid=paste("S", 1:37, sep=""),
  T1=structure(c(14862, 14879, 14892, 14918, 14919, 14919, 14919, 
    14947, 14948, 14962, 14997, 15010, 15019, 15031, 15031, 15045, 
    15058, 15073, 15074, 15087, 15115, 15115, 15130, 15130, 15143, 
    15234, 15241, 15269, 15312, 15347, 15354, 15409, 15445, 15451, 
    15471, 15515, 15520), class = "Date"),
  T2=structure(c(8774, 8727, 9489, 9462, 9776, 8477, 9019, 9207, 9452, 
    10108, 9407, 8898, 9363, 9361, 9416, 8682, 8895, 8605, 8707, 
    9140, 9289, 9330, 9311, 9633, 8927, 9308, 9924, 9004, 8986, 9000, 
    9772, 10649, 9288, 9856, 8968, 9081, 9798), class = "Date"))


df$age.in.weeks=difftime(df$T1, df$T2, units="weeks")
df$age.in.weeks=as.numeric(df$age.in.weeks)
df$age.in.years=(df$age.in.weeks)/52

range=seq(min(floor(df$age.in.years)), max(ceiling(df$age.in.years)), by=1)
my.base.size=18  
graph=
  ggplot(df, aes(x=age.in.weeks)) +
  stat_bin(breaks=range) +
  theme_bw(base_size =  my.base.size) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set1") +
  labs(x="Age (years)") +
  opts(legend.position="none")

print(graph)


Error in if (nrow(layer_data) == 0) return() : argument is of length zero

In addition: Warning messages:

1: Removed 5 rows containing missing values (position_stack). 

2: In min(x) : no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf

3: In max(x) : no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf

4: position_stack requires constant width: output may be incorrect

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: problems specifying bin breaks in stat_bin
parts:
There are no values of age.in.weeks within the range of range:

> range(range)
[1] 13 18
> range(df$age.in.weeks)
[1] 680 929

Probably you want aes(x=age.in.years) instead of aes(x=age.in.weeks).

Best,
Ista

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: problems specifying bin breaks in stat_bin
parts:
Hi:

I believe you're thinking way too hard. Is this more or less what you want?

ggplot(df, aes(x = floor(age.in.years))) +
    geom_histogram(fill = "blue", colour = "black", binwidth = 1) +
    theme_bw(base_size = my.base.size) +
    labs(x = "Age (years)") +
    xlim(13, 18)


Dennis
